decisions.decision: Accept spaces in a local-path url; remote addresses and path_filter keep refusing them; a space followed by - stays refused
decisions.why: User decision 2026-10-19: folders with spaces are common on macOS and FR-006 quoting makes them safe; the dash guard keeps the leading - rule true for every piece the shell would see if a quote were missed
decisions.rejected: Refusing spaces everywhere and pointing users to a symbolic link

decisions.decision: Single-quote every configuration placeholder in the bash blocks; a quote inside a value is written as close-quote, backslash-quote, reopen
decisions.why: Single quotes stop all expansion and splitting in sh, bash and zsh, and the escape keeps that true when validation is bypassed
decisions.rejected: Double quotes (still run command substitution), a quoted heredoc per value, a temp file per value, environment variables

decisions.decision: State the quoting rule inside the duplicated Configuration Validation Rules block
decisions.why: configure, sync and status all carry it, static check 11 keeps the copies identical, and it extends the existing leading-dash account
decisions.rejected: One copy in the sync Algorithm Reference; a shared file, which constitution I forbids

decisions.decision: The agent applies the character rule in its own reasoning; no validation snippet
decisions.why: A snippet would hand the unchecked value to a shell in order to check it
decisions.rejected: A case pattern or a tr filter run in the shell

decisions.decision: Accept letters, digits and . _ ~ : / @ % + - in url and path_filter; spaces only in local paths and never before a dash; local paths start with ~/ (not ~user/); a path_filter must not begin with ~; wildcards refused
decisions.why: Covers the supported address forms listed in SC-002. Previously accepted bracketed IPv6 addresses and other discontinued values are documented as a breaking change in configuration schema 1.1
decisions.rejected: A deny-list of known metacharacters

decisions.decision: A refused value never reaches a shell: status shows invalid, sync prunes nothing that run, remove deletes the entry and leaves the cache to the next prune, search skips the source
decisions.why: Computing a slug is the one place quoting would have to hold for a value that really contains a quote or a line break
decisions.rejected: Computing the slug of a refused value under the quoting rule

decisions.decision: Use a slug only when it is 12 lowercase hex characters, and delete only directories so named, only when every expected slug has that form
decisions.why: Run as written in zsh the slug procedure yields an empty slug, which turns cache/<slug>/ into the cache root
decisions.rejected: Trusting the fixed procedure

decisions.decision: Fetched file names travel only through variables and redirection; find starting points get ./; item lines with a .. segment or a leading / are dropped; manifest and index are written with the file tool
decisions.why: File names come from whoever controls the source and no configuration rule sees them
decisions.rejected: NUL-separated lists, which are not POSIX and which dash cannot read

decisions.decision: Every message is agent output, never echo or printf, with control characters escaped in any quoted value, label or file name
decisions.why: echo around a refused value runs its command substitution, and labels and file names can carry terminal escapes
decisions.rejected: A character rule for labels only

decisions.decision: Fix the slug procedure: comments off the continuation lines, explicit url and revision assignments, printf instead of echo, the real worked example
decisions.why: As written, zsh fails and sh and bash hash an empty address, so unpinned sources share e3b0c44298fc; output for every accepted value is unchanged
decisions.rejected: Keeping echo, whose backslash handling differs by shell

decisions.decision: Static check 12 tracks effective quote contexts and escapes across physical lines, rejects unsafe or ambiguous placeholder contexts, and checks inert negative fixtures; <slug> is the only exemption
decisions.why: Removing apparent single-quoted segments accepts single quotes inside double quotes even though command substitution remains active there; analysis finding I1 requires a context-aware fail-closed check
decisions.rejected: Regex-only removal of single-quoted segments; a fixed placeholder list; shell-executing scanner fixtures in CI

decisions.decision: Extend the local behaviour test: literal quoting-aware substitution, 8 hostile seeds, a local path with a space, slug runs in sh, bash and zsh, hostile file names
decisions.why: sed reads a pipe, an ampersand, a backslash or a line break in a value as syntax, so seeds would pass for the wrong reason
decisions.rejected: Running the test in CI, which needs its own constitution amendment
